verdict.rationale: Flagright's llms.txt tells AI clients such as Claude Code and Cursor to connect to a first-party MCP server at docs.flagright.com/_mcp/server, and a probe confirms the llms.txt is live. That endpoint sits on the documentation domain, so it appears to serve documentation rather than let an agent act on Flagright's compliance API (users, transactions, cases, rules). missing for 10: an MCP server exposing product API operations, documented tool list and auth/setup, a direct probe of the MCP endpoint, independent or hands-on corroboration.
